title: Separate plugin dependency installer, import environment, conflict, and redaction boundaries
description: TASK-018 defines dependency plans, but AstrBot's pip installer shows that real plugin dependency installation includes package parsing, site-packages preference, conflict classification, core-version constraints, packaged-runtime patches, and secret redaction. Rust should keep dependency installation and import-environment policy separate from plugin metadata loading.

files.change: Execute dependency plans through a replaceable installer instead of embedding install logic in PluginLoader.
Model isolated dependency roots, package preference, and runtime-specific import behavior.
Keep version/core conflicts and safe user-facing errors out of loader state transitions.

criteria: PluginLoader depends on dependency ports, not concrete package installation mechanics.
Dependency conflict errors are classified and redact secrets before reaching logs or dashboard APIs.
Native Rust plugins and future Python compatibility can share the dependency plan boundary.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-plugin && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
